works.title: How METIS works
works.subtitle: Intelligent pathfinding that adapts to your pace and the way you learn.
works.step1Body: Define what you want to master. METIS maps the terrain and calculates the optimal route.
works.step2Body: Curated, high-signal resources delivered in a logical, step-by-step sequence.
works.step3Body: Struggling with a concept? METIS reroutes to clearer explanations before you fall behind.

values.mappingBody: Dynamic knowledge graphs that track exactly what you know and where the gaps are.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How exactly does the “GPS” adaptivity work?
faq.a1: Just like a GPS reroutes you when you miss a turn, METIS reroutes your roadmap when you struggle with a concept. It finds the gap, then adjusts pacing, ordering, and resources so you never stay stuck.
faq.q2: Where do the resources come from?
faq.a2: METIS curates from across the open web and trusted providers, then structures them into a path instead of a pile of links. All resources are free and open for you to access.
faq.q3: Do I need to know how to structure my learning?
faq.a3: No. You bring the goal, and METIS brings the structure, pacing, and ordering. It saves you the time of hunting for resources and deciding what to study next.
faq.a4: There is a free tier with one learning journey, and a Premium tier that unlocks unlimited journeys, analytics, and the adaptive tutor. See the pricing page for details.
